claims.object_text: genetic epilepsy with febrile seizures plus (GEFS + ) syndrome
claims.quote: A pathogenic variant in SCN1A can result in a spectrum of phenotypes, including Dravet syndrome (DS) and genetic epilepsy with febrile seizures plus (GEFS + ) syndrome.

claims.object_text: behavioral problems in the clinical range on the A/CBCL total problems scale
claims.quote: Forty-six DS participants (43.0 %) and three GEFS + participants (7.5 %) showed behavioral problems in the clinical range on the A/CBCL total problems scale.

claims.object_text: withdrawn behavior, aggressive behavior, and attention problems
claims.quote: The behavioral profile in DS exists out of withdrawn behavior, aggressive behavior, and attention problems.

claims.object_text: sleep disturbances associated with behavioral difficulties
claims.quote: In DS patients, sleep disturbances (β = 1.15, p < 0.001) and a lower age (β = -0.21, p = 0.001) were significantly associated with behavioral difficulties.

claims.object_text: behavioral difficulties decrease with age in DS participants
claims.quote: Between 2015 and 2022, behavioral difficulties significantly decreased with age (t = -2.24, CI = -6.10 - -0.15, p = 0.04) in DS participants aging from adolescence into adulthood.

claims.object_text: behavioral difficulties are a core feature of the DS phenotype
claims.quote: These findings suggest that, in addition to epilepsy, behavioral difficulties are a core feature of the DS phenotype.

claims.object_text: decrease in intellectual functioning as a risk factor for developing (more) behavioral difficulties
claims.quote: A decrease in intellectual functioning (β = 3.37, p = 0.02) and using less antiseizure medications in 2022 than in 2015, (β = -1.96, p = 0.04), were identified as possible risk factors for developing (more) behavioral difficulties.
